regarding potentially the rudest receptionist I've ever come across! I asked for a fit to work statement and they tried to charge me £20, which is completely and totally illegal (ask the DWP). I am seriously considering taking this further as people like her shouldn't work with vulnerable people. Magically, after being forced to become irate with her, she miraculously managed to book me in next day, after being completely adament they're full up for a month! I later rang to find out her name (Bethan) and she was possibly the single most sarcastic, demeaning and patronising person I have ever had the displeasure of speaking to. I will be following this up with further, private authorities. If you're reading this, Bethan, look into a new career path, perhaps in a warehouse where you don't have to interact with potentially difficult public.

I am fortunate in that my mental illness is manageable (with correct help), but for anyone else that phonecall could have been the end of their lives. Other people are iller than myself and it is simply not acceptable to treat them this way. I would get sacked on the spot if i was to speak to anyone the way Bethan spoke to me, and rightly so, and I work in a cafe!

Walking into the reception to pick up a registration form, the elderly lady at the left-hand-side desk was extremely rude. She didn't say a word and silently pointed to another desk where nobody was. Turns out the entire reception team was on a lunch break
(why they need to take their breaks together I have no idea) and we had to wait 15 minutes to even get a form, regardless of the fact the woman on the other side was sitting there with a face like thunder doing absolutely nothing.

Okay so first impressions aside, I needed to make an appointment this week for a doctor to sign a form (urgent for me). Called on Monday, after 20 minutes of 'line busy', a rude lady answered and told us we can't have an appointment because it's 'triage day' on Mondays and Tuesdays. So we protested, and she said she'd get the doctor to call. Obviously, the doctor never called.

So we waited until today (Wednesday) to phone up, which was the absolute last day I could get this form signed. Again, 20 minutes of 'line busy' (how about you get more than one phone line? You have enough receptionists sitting around), and another rude lady answered and said the same thing again - it's not urgent (in her 'professional' opinion) and therefore we can't have an appointment until next week.

I also have medication that I need to see a doctor to get, and I have now been cold turkey for a month thanks to this practice. It's a repeat prescription, but since they appear to have their own rules, I have to make appointments which, again, takes around a month minimum.

How anyone goes about getting seen by a doctor here is anyone's guess. It seems like they only have receptionists and they're all trained to get rid of people. I've seen people saying they're racist, but I wouldn't go there (though there's no smoke without fire). I think they just hate people of all races.

I should note, I have worked with the public for 16 years now and have never once even thought about speaking to a customer the way Bethan spoke to me.
